## Discovery/extraction boundary

A separate discovery stage has already built the candidate source catalogue shown in Resources already identified. This turn is evidence extraction and gap-directed inspection, not the primary broad-discovery pass. Open and inspect at least {opened_document_target} of the most promising candidates across independent source families when access permits, then extract located facts. Perform additional searches only for a concrete factual, attribution, contrary-evidence, or source-family gap exposed during inspection. Evidence-unit targets are depth diagnostics and must not be used as proof that the source universe is saturated. For every candidate actually inspected, emit one SOURCE_CANDIDATE_JSON line using the discovery contract and change access_status to accepted, rejected, opened, or access_blocked. accepted means at least one SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON evidence record was retained from that same URL; rejected means it was inspected but provided no usable evidence. If access prevents the inspection target, emit INSPECTION_SATURATION_BLOCKER_JSON with chapter_id, a nonempty documents_attempted array, and a concrete limitation.
